questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Savita will deliver a speech on the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti.

options.text: On the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti a speech is being delivered by Savita.
On the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti a speech was delivered by Savita.
On the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti a speech will be delivered by Savita.
On the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti a speech is to be delivered by Savita.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**On the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti a speech will be delivered by Savita**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• In **Active Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In **Passive Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice** and '**Savita**' is the **subject **and ''**on the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti**'' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a **passive voice**, the **subject 'Savita**' of the active voice **becomes **the **object**, the **object **''**on the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti''****becomes **the **subject**.
 
• The passive format **"'will + be + V3 (delivered)"** should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice **rule **for the **future simple tense.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3*.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png]

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He invited me to his place yesterday.

options.text: I invited to his place yesterday.
I was invited.
I was invited by him to his place yesterday.
To his place I was invited yesterday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'I was invited by him to his place yesterday'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Active Voice**. As per the question we have to change it into** Passive Voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject +V2 + Object. **(Active Voice)**
 
• Subject(objective case) + was/were +V3 + by + Object(subjective case)**. (Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is **'he'.**
 
• **The object** of the given sentence is** 'me'.**
 
• **The subject** will be put in place of **the object** and **the object **will be put in place of** the subject.**

**Correct sentence:**__ I was invited by him to his place yesterday.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The maid was dusting the hall when the door-bell rang.

options.text: The door-bell rang when the maid is dusting the hall.
The door-bell rang by the maid when the hall was dusted.
The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid.
The door-bell rang when the maid was dusting the hall.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Form. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence as follows:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him.*
 
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. 
 
• The given sentence has **two clauses.**
 
• We have to change the **voice** of part one that is *'The maid was dusting the hall...'*
 
• **'was dusting'** will be changed into **'was being dusted'.**
 
• The **subject** will be put in place of the **object** and the **object** will be put in place of the **subject**.
 
• The preposition 'by' will be added.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 ​

**Correct Sentence__**: *The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Active Voice** में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को **Passive Voice** में बदलना है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him.*
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **'past continuous'** का उदाहरण है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में **'two clauses'** हैं।
 
• हमें पहले भाग की **voice** को बदलना होगा i.e. *'The maid was dusting the hall...'*
 
• **'was dusting'** को** 'was being dusted' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **Object** के स्थान पर **Subject** रखा जाएगा और **Subject** के स्थान पर **Object** रखी जाएगी।
 
• The preposition '**by**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Transformation of **Infinitives**:
 
• Structure of it is as follows
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had + to+ V1+ Object. 
 
• Subject(Objective case) + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had+to+be+ V3 + by+ object(subjective case). 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Your child is to learn chess. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Chess is to be learnt by your child. (Passive Voice)*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The student asked the teacher a question during class.

options.text: A question was asked by the student to the teacher during class.
A question is being asked by the student to the teacher during class.
A question asked by the student to the teacher during class.
A question will be asked by the student to the teacher during class.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**A question was asked by the student to the teacher during class.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Active voice structure**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 
• **Passive Voice structure**: __Object of the Active + "to be" verb + Past Participle of the Main Verb + by + Subject of the Active Voice__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject (**student**) performing the action (**asking the question**) on the object (**teacher**).
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object (**a question**) the subject of the sentence, and the subject (**student**) will become the object of the preposition "**by**".
 
• The verb "**asked**" will become "**was asked**", and the preposition "**to**" will become "**by**".
 
• The phrase "**during class**" can remain at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**

questions.question:
Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.

Ravi gave you the information?

options.text: Was the information given to you by Ravi?
Have the information been given to you?
Has the information given to you?
You have been given the information?

questions.solution:
The correct passive form of the sentence is option **1) "Was the information given to you by Ravi?**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active sentence "Ravi gave you the information," the subject "Ravi" performs the action on the object "you" and "the information."
 
• In the passive form, the object becomes the subject of the sentence, and the subject becomes the object.
 
• Here's an explanation of how the active sentence "Ravi gave you the information" is transformed into the passive form "Was the information given to you by Ravi?" using the rules for converting from active to passive voice:
 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object:
 
 
• Subject: Ravi
 
• Verb: gave
 
• Object: the information
 
 
 
• Move the object to the beginning of the sentence and make it the subject of the passive sentence:
 
 
• The information
 
 
 
• Use the appropriate form of the verb "be" (in this case, "was") followed by the past participle of the main verb (in this case, "given"):
 
 
• Was given
 
 
 
• Include the preposition "by" followed by the agent (the person or thing performing the action):
 
 
• By Ravi
 
 
 
• If there is an indirect object in the active sentence (in this case, "you"), include it after the preposition "to":
 
 
• To you
 
 
 
• Putting it all together, we get the passive form: "**Was the information given to you by Ravi?**"
 
 
• This passive sentence correctly conveys that the information was given by Ravi to you.

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

He spent a lot of money on movies.

options.text: A lot of money had been spent by him on movies.
A lot of money is spent by him on movies.
A lot of money was spent by him on movies.
A lot of money was being spent by him on movies.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'A lot of money was spent by him on movies.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is in **Active Voice.** As per the given question we have to change it into **Passive Voice. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows: 
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is **'He'. **
 
• **The object** of the given sentence is **'A lot of money'. **
 
• **The subject** will be put in place of **the object** and **the object **will be put in place of **the subject. **
 
• **'Spent'** will be changed into** 'was spent' **because we know that** V₂ **is changed into** 'was+V₃.'**
 
• **'He'** will be changed into **'him'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3. **

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *A lot of money was spent by him on movies. *

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

My father cooks breakfast every day.

options.text: Breakfast was being cooked every day by my father.
Breakfast was cooked every day by my father.
Breakfast is cooked every day by my father.
Breakfast was cook every day by my father.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct passive form** of the sentence is **option 3:*** "Breakfast is cooked every day by my father."*
 
• In the original sentence, **"My father"** is the subject, **"cooks"** is the verb in simple present tense, and **"breakfast"** is the object. 
 
• **When we convert **this into the passive voice, the object ("breakfast") becomes the subject, the verb ("cooks") changes to its past participle form ("cooked"), and the original subject ("my father") is preceded by "by". 
 
• **We also use "is" **before the verb to keep it in the present tense, resulting in "Breakfast is cooked every day by my father."

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'Breakfast is cooked every day by my father.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through all the options:
 
 
• **"Breakfast was being cooked every day by my father." **This is incorrect because it uses the past continuous tense ("was being cooked") instead of the simple present tense.
 
• **"Breakfast was cooked every day by my father."** This is incorrect because it uses the simple past tense ("was cooked") instead of the simple present tense.
 
• **"Breakfast was cook every day by my father."** This is incorrect due to the grammatical error "was cook" and the use of the past tense "was".

questions.question:

options.text: Vast valleys can be seen sloping into the distance.
Vast valleys had been seen sloping into the distance.

• The subject of the given sentence is 'You'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Vast valleys'. 
 
• Since modal verb has been used in the active voice, therefore, the passive voice will follow the given structure:
 
 
• Active Voice - modal verb*(can) *+ V1 
 
• Passive Voice - modal verb*(can)* + be + V3 
 
 
 
• Here, 'can see' will be changed into 'can be seen' because in 'active to passive' transformation third form of the verb is used.
